text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos. Preserve individual face, skin tone and age from reference.  One original fictional adult man. East Asian man with pale ash-blond feathered hair, quiet gentle romantic energy, plain black open-collar shirt. Facial design: elongated heart face, wider cheekbones, rounded strong chin, straight thick brows, small upturned eyes with subtle lids, short refined nose with slightly broad base, wide lips with a defined cupid bow. Fair neutral skin. Black long-sleeve open-collar shirt with rolled cuffs tucked into black tailored trousers, black belt and black loafers. Graceful lean 187cm build. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
